faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MOCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MOCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Young Professional (General Background), 1 Young Professional (Environment Background).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MOCA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 7 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 21-32 years of age (as of the date of advertisement of the vacancy).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 50,000 per month for Young Professional (General Background), Rs. 54,000 per month for Young Professional (Environment Background).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's Degree for General Background; Post Graduate Degree in Environmental Sciences for Environment Background. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Proficient in creating and managing digital interactive platforms for Environment Background. Good communication skills in Hindi and English.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Oral Test/Interview. Selection shall be conducted through Oral Test/Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on a contract basis for a period of one year. Maximum extendable by further two years, subject to performance and requirement basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: New Delhi.
